🚨 Fully Funded PhD Opportunity in the USA – Spring 2027 🇺🇸

Applications are now open for a Fully Funded PhD Position in Molecular Parasitology at Texas State University in the Mukherjee Lab (Department of Biology).

The successful candidate will conduct cutting-edge research on malaria pathogenesis, focusing on membrane protein biogenesis in Plasmodium falciparum using molecular biology, cell biology, and biochemistry approaches.

🎓 Funding Includes:
✅ Competitive graduate stipend
✅ Full tuition coverage
✅ Health insurance

📅 Application Review Begins: 15 August 2026

This is an outstanding opportunity for aspiring researchers passionate about infectious diseases, molecular parasitology, and global health.

🔗Apply: https://t.co/H6XzRWn5Ig

#PhD #FullyFundedPhD #TexasStateUniversity #MolecularParasitology #MalariaResearch #PlasmodiumFalciparum #Biology #MolecularBiology #CellBiology #Biochemistry #GraduateSchool #PhDOpportunity #Scholarships #StudyInUSA #GlobalHealth #ResearchCareers #STEM #OppNextNews
chinese_translation:
🚨 美国全额资助博士机会 – 2027年春季 🇺🇸

得克萨斯州立大学生物学系Mukherjee实验室现开放分子寄生虫学全额资助博士职位申请。

成功候选人将开展疟疾发病机制的前沿研究，重点关注恶性疟原虫（Plasmodium falciparum）中膜蛋白生物发生，使用分子生物学、细胞生物学和生物化学方法。

🎓 资助包括：
✅ 有竞争力的研究生津贴
✅ 全额学费覆盖
✅ 健康保险

📅 申请审查开始：2026年8月15日

这是热衷于传染病、分子寄生虫学和全球健康的有志研究者的绝佳机会。
research_focus: Molecular Parasitology, Malaria, Membrane Protein Biogenesis
application_notes: Application Review Begins: 15 August 2026; Fully funded (stipend, tuition, insurance); Start Spring 2027
